title: Small etale structure-ring map and module direct image
statement: Let $a:V\to U$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Use their small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], with the regular-function structure rings and module categories of [def-sfb-scheme-zariski-etale-module-constructions], and module sheaves as in [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. The base-change functor sends $(W\to U)$ to $(W\times_U V\to V)$. Define the structure-ring map $\mathcal O_{U,\mathrm{et}}\to a_{\mathrm{et},*}\mathcal O_{V,\mathrm{et}}$ on $W$ to be pullback of regular functions along $\mathrm{pr}_1:W\times_U V\to W$. Define module direct image by $a_{\mathrm{et},*}N(W)=N(W\times_U V)$ with its $\mathcal O_U(W)$-module structure obtained by restriction of scalars along this ring map, and with restrictions induced by base change of etale morphisms. These are the canonical ring map and module pushforward, with no choice of an isomorphism or additional map.
